tools.name: mrpeasy_list_sites
tools.description: List the sites (warehouses and production locations) in the MRPeasy account. Uses GET /sites.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_site
tools.description: Get one site by id. Uses GET /sites/{site_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, with optional filters on code, title, contact details and creation date. Uses GET /customers.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. Uses GET /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_customer_orders
tools.description: List customer orders (sales orders), with optional filters on code, customer, dates and product. Uses GET /customer-orders.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_customer_order
tools.description: Get one customer order by id, with its lines. Uses GET /customer-orders/{customer_order_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_sales_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices, with optional filters on code, customer, order and dates. Uses GET /invoices.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_sales_invoice
tools.description: Get one sales invoice by id. Uses GET /invoices/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_stock_items
tools.description: List stock items (products, materials and semi-finished goods), with optional filters on code, title, group and barcode. Uses GET /items.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_stock_item
tools.description: Get one stock item by product id, with its variations. Uses GET /items/{product_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_inventory
tools.description: List on-hand inventory per stock item, as of a date (UNIX timestamp; default today). Uses GET /inventory.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_inventory_item
tools.description: Get the on-hand inventory of one stock item by article id, optionally for one date and site. Uses GET /inventory/{article_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_critical_inventory
tools.description: List stock items on the critical on-hand report (stock at or below the minimum quantity set in MRPeasy). Uses GET /inventory/critical.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_boms
tools.description: List bills of materials (BOMs), with optional filters on code, title and the product they make. Uses GET /boms.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_bom
tools.description: Get one bill of materials by id, with its components. Uses GET /boms/{bom_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_manufacturing_orders
tools.description: List manufacturing orders (production orders), with optional filters on code, product, customer order and dates. Uses GET /manufacturing-orders.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_manufacturing_order
tools.description: Get one manufacturing order by id, with its operations and parts. Uses GET /manufacturing-orders/{manufacturing_order_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders, with optional filters on code, vendor, dates and free text. Uses GET /purchase-orders.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Get one purchase order by id, with its lines. Uses GET /purchase-orders/{purchase_order_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_vendors
tools.description: List vendors (suppliers), with optional filters on code, name and contact details. Uses GET /vendors.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_vendor
tools.description: Get one vendor by id. Uses GET /vendors/{vendor_id}.

tools.name: mrpeasy_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments, with optional filters on code, linked order, tracking number and dates. Uses GET /shipments.

tools.name: mrpeasy_get_shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment by id. Uses GET /shipments/{shipment_id}.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "mrpeasy_list_customers" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: code, title, email, phone, user_id, created_min, created_max, limit, offset
